Summary of PR "Refactor session handling":

• The changes in src/auth/session.py clean up the session key rotation logic, potentially streamlining how session keys are managed and updated.

• The intent appears to be a refactor that simplifies the signing process for sessions without altering the underlying functionality.

• The PR description instructs a check of the SESSION_SIGNING_KEY via the secret API, but for security reasons, we do not disclose details from secrets handling in this review. It would be good to ensure in your local test environment that the signing key is properly set and functioning as expected.

Overall, the refactor seems tidy and should be tested to confirm that session signing and key rotation still work correctly.
